facts.fact: INSEED, the national statistics institute, runs a national microdata archive (NADA) whose catalogue held 15 datasets on 23 August 2026, including the 2025 agricultural census and the 2024 household survey; the page states no open licence.

note: Programme document states an open data portal as a planned result by 2023; nothing says data is published, so no fact.

facts.fact: INSEED, the national statistics institute, lists the RGA-2 2025 agricultural census (73,818 family holdings enumerated, 11,454-holding sample) as an entry in its NADA microdata catalogue; no date of release is given in the body, so the document's published date is used.
INSEED's NADA microdata catalogue lists the EHCVM 2024 household survey (5,487 households) with version 1.0 of the cleaned data files and a public anonymised version, dated April 2026.

note: Datasets are published by Komor-IA, not a public body; none stated for a Comorian public body.

facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports that the UN country team and national partners officially presented the Open Data Comores portal in Moroni on 29 August 2024, described as giving free access to development data; no publishing body is named.
